record.hypothesis: Using libjpeg-turbo quantized coefficients and a pinned double-precision 8×8 IDCT basis, the prototype omits transform contributions only when their conservative absolute contribution plus rounding allowance remains within the requested per-pixel budget. An additional 50,000 adversarial coefficient blocks produced 0 bound violations; the worst observed error/certificate ratio was 0.999700. This validates the certificate for the pinned reconstruction model, not yet a production JPEG decoder.
